##### Project general facts

Ellington Collection at Downtown is a refined residential development designed for contemporary urban lifestyles in the heart of Dubai. The architecture features a sleek glass façade that wraps the building in a modern, elegant expression, reflecting the dynamic character of Downtown living. Each residence is thoughtfully designed to balance beauty and functionality, with spaces that flow seamlessly and adapt to the evolving needs of modern city life.

The development offers a curated residential experience defined by thoughtful design and elevated lifestyle convenience. From a striking entrance lobby to carefully composed interior environments, every detail is crafted to create a sense of arrival and refinement. The project emphasizes a sophisticated urban living experience, where architecture, light, and space work together to create a cohesive and inspiring environment.

The interiors are finished with premium materials and a bold, contemporary design language, featuring warm color palettes, sculptural lighting, and elegant detailing throughout. Residences include high ceilings, premium tile flooring in key living areas, and expansive floor-to-ceiling windows with panoramic Downtown views. The kitchens are equipped with professional-grade Miele appliances, combining performance with refined design. The units feature bespoke fitted wardrobes and walk-in closet solutions, and are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalize their homes according to their own style and preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

As the name suggests, Downtown Dubai is the centre of Dubai, constantly evolving at a fast pace. Home to many landmarks and world-famous attractions, including Burj Khalifa, the Dubai Mall and Dancing Fountains, the area is a hub of activities. The prime location keeps Downtown busy throughout the year. Constantly attracting tourists, there’re always some new things to do in Downtown Dubai.

The area is best known for offering a luxurious lifestyle. It used to be a vertical community, but many villas have also been added to the real estate market. As per Bayut’s 2020 Rental Market Report, it is the second most popular area offering luxury apartments for rent after Dubai Marina. Downtown is well connected to other key commercial and residential areas in the city. 

Strategically located along Sheikh Zayed Road, E11, across Al Wasl and bordering Business Bay, it is a pretty active and bustling neighbourhood. Downtown is one of Dubai’s best areas for non-drivers and frequent travellers. Many amenities, including upscale hotels, chic leisure points and massive shopping centres, make Downtown Dubai a sought-after address and “the centre of now.”
